items.title: CVE-2022-0185: Linux kernel privilege escalation via heap overflow in filesystem parser (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A heap buffer overflow in the Linux kernel's filesystem context handling lets a local attacker escalate privileges to root, and container escape has also been reported. The attacker reaches it locally by opening a filesystem that falls back to legacy handling, and attacks using this flaw are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: CVE-2022-1096: Google Chrome memory corruption in V8 via type confusion (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Google Chrome has a type confusion flaw in its V8 engine that an attacker can reach remotely, without logging in, by getting a user to open a crafted HTML page. This can corrupt memory, and the related advisory says the worst of the bundled Chromium issues could allow remote code execution; attacks using this bug are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: CVE-2022-0847: Linux kernel root privilege escalation in pipe buffer handling (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Linux kernel's pipe handling leaves a pipe buffer setting uninitialized, so a local attacker with a low-privilege account can overwrite data in read-only files through the page cache and escalate privileges to root, for example by injecting code into root processes. Attacks using this bug are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: CVE-2026-131914: Idunno AntiCsrf remote code execution in ASP.NET CSRF token validation (Update: added to CISA KEV)

items.title: CVE-2022-23131: Zabbix Frontend authentication bypass in SAML session storage (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Zabbix Frontend is affected when SAML single sign-on is enabled, which is not the default setup. An attacker can reach it remotely without logging in, change the session data, and gain admin access, as long as they know a valid Zabbix username or the guest account is enabled. It is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2022-22963: Spring Cloud Function remote code execution in SpEL routing expressions (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Cloud Function's routing functionality is affected by a flaw that lets an attacker run code and access local resources by sending a specially crafted SpEL routing expression, remotely and without logging in. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and attacks using this bug are happening.

items.title: blankspace
items.summary: Blank Space Blank Space is a refactoring of James Forshaw's original proof of concept for CVE-2021-43893, EFSRPC arbitrary file upload privilege escalation. Blank Space can create arbitrary files on a remote host that is using unconstrained delegation if it isn't patched for CVE-2021-43893. File creation is done using the privileges of the remote user, so code execution is a bit speculative but defintely a possibility. Blank Space can also be used to begin a relay attack even after CVE-2021-43893 has been patched. Similarly, admin users can overwrite existing files, although that arguably does…

items.title: CVE-2026-132694 | Wikimedia MediaWiki up to 1.46.2/1.47 OATHAuth src/Key/WebAuthnKey.php privilege escalation
items.summary: A vulnerability, which was classified as critical , has been found in Wikimedia MediaWiki up to 1.46.2/1.47 . This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file src/Key/WebAuthnKey.php of the component OATHAuth . This manipulation causes privilege escalation. The identification of this vulnerability is CVE-2026-132694 . It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. There is no exploit available. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-134401: Google Chrome remote code execution in Variations (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Google Chrome has an input validation flaw in its Variations component. A remote attacker could use a specially crafted HTML page to potentially run arbitrary code outside the browser sandbox.

items.title: CVE-2022-24086: Adobe Magento Commerce remote code execution in checkout input validation (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Adobe Commerce (Magento Commerce) has an input validation flaw in its checkout process that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the server. The attack can be carried out remotely, without logging in or any user interaction, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-20699: Cisco Small Business RV Series Router Firmware unauthenticated remote code execution in HTTP server (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Cisco Small Business RV Series Router Firmware, used on RV160, RV260, RV340 and RV345 routers, has vulnerabilities that let a remote attacker run arbitrary code with root privileges on the router by sending crafted HTTP requests, without logging in. Attacks using these flaws are happening, and exploitation is most relevant for RV340 and RV345 routers acting as an SSL VPN gateway.

items.title: CVE-2022-22954: VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager remote code execution via server-side template injection (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager have a server-side template injection flaw that lets an attacker run their own code on the server. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-22965: Spring remote code execution via data binding (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Framework applications using Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux on JDK 9 or later can be taken over through data binding, letting an attacker run code on the application server remotely without logging in. The known exploit needs a non-default setup, with the app deployed as a WAR on Tomcat rather than as a Spring Boot executable jar, and attacks are happening, since the bug is listed in CISA'...

items.title: CVE-2022-24112: Apache APISIX auth bypass in batch-requests plugin via X-REAL-IP (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache APISIX, through its batch-requests plugin, lets an attacker overwrite the client IP header and bypass the Admin API IP restriction, which in a default setup with the default API key leads to remote code execution; otherwise the data panel IP restriction can still be bypassed. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-24990: Unauthenticated remote code execution in web interface (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. TerraMaster NAS devices are affected by a flaw that lets an attacker run code on the device, such as uploading a PHP webshell, by abusing PHP object instantiation. It can be reached remotely without logging in, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-21882: Microsoft privilege escalation in Win32k (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Win32k component of Microsoft Windows 10 and Windows Server (including Windows Server 2019 and 2022) lets an attacker gain higher privileges than they should have. The attacker must already be able to run code on the machine with a low-privilege account, and this flaw is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-21999: Microsoft privilege escalation in print spooler service (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Windows Print Spooler service on several Microsoft Windows 10 and Windows Server releases lets an attacker raise their privileges to take much greater control of the system. The attacker must already have a low-privileged account on the machine, and no action from another user is needed. This bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-0995: Linux kernel privilege escalation via watch_queue out-of-bounds write (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Linux kernel's watch_queue event notification subsystem has an out-of-bounds memory write flaw that can overwrite kernel state, letting an attacker gain privileged access or crash the system. It is reached locally by someone who already has a low-privilege login, and it is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-136455
items.summary: borg-ui before 2.4.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows a repository-scoped operator to escalate to full administrator by exploiting an unrestricted source_directories field in the backup-plan API that lacks path allow-listing. Attackers can configure a backup plan to archive the application's data directory, download the resulting archive to extract the static HS256 .secret_key, and use it to forge a JWT with sub":"admin" to access admin-only endpoints like GET /api/auth/users, achieving full application takeover without admin credentials, XSS, or CSRF.

items.title: CVE-2026-136241
items.summary: UWAS before 0.11.16 contains a WAF bypass vulnerability in the isAPContentType() function within internal/middleware/security.go that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade SQL injection, XSS, and shell/RCE body pattern detection by setting the Content-Type header to application/json, multipart/form-data, or other exempted types. Attackers can relabel the Content-Type of malicious requests to skip WAF body scanning entirely, causing the unfiltered payload to pass through byte-for-byte to the backend application without being logged as a WAF event.

items.title: CVE-2022-0778: Infinite loop in BN_mod_sqrt() reachable when parsing certificates (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Software that parses certificates, including OpenSSL and the mariadb, mysql-client, and node packages, contains an infinite loop in BN_mod_sqrt(). A remote attacker can trigger it without logging in, causing a denial of service by sending a crafted certificate, which is parsed before its signature is checked. Public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2011-10019: Spreecommerce remote code execution in search parameter (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Spreecommerce versions prior to 0.60.2 contains a remote command execution vulnerability in its search functionality. The application fails to properly sanitize input passed via the search[send][] parameter, which is dynamically invoked using Ruby’s send method. This allows attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands on the server without authentication.

items.title: CVE-2011-10026: Spreecommerce remote code execution in API search parameter (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Spreecommerce versions prior to 0.50.x contain a remote command execution vulnerability in the API's search functionality. Improper input sanitation allows attackers to inject arbitrary shell commands via the search[instance_eval] parameter, which is dynamically invoked using Ruby’s send method. This flaw enables unauthenticated attackers to execute commands on the server.

items.title: CVE-2022-21971: Microsoft Windows code execution in WinRT (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in Microsoft's Windows Runtime, which affects several Windows 10 and Windows Server releases, lets an attacker run code of their choosing on the affected system. The attacker needs local access but no login, and a user must take some action, such as opening something, to trigger it. Public exploit code exists and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-22947: Spring Cloud Gateway remote code injection in actuator endpoint (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Cloud Gateway is vulnerable to code injection that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code on the host by sending a crafted request, without logging in. This only works with a non-default setup in which the Gateway Actuator endpoint is enabled, exposed and unsecured, and public exploit code exists (including a Metasploit module) and attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-135768
items.summary: A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used for managing authentication and authorization flows. The issue occurs when a client policy is configured to enforce a high-assurance authentication flow requiring OTP. Due to improper validation of existing sessions, a lower-assurance password-only SSO session can be incorrectly accepted if the request does not explicitly demand a specific assurance level. This allows an attacker with access to a user's password or session to bypass the second factor and obtain tokens claiming a higher level of security.

items.title: CVE-2026-133461
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.10.0, the OAuth authorize endpoint redirects to unvalidated error redirect targets. An attacker can craft a link on the platform's own domain that redirects a signed-in user to an attacker-controlled site, which can present a lookalike consent or sign-in page to harvest credentials. This issue is fixed in version 0.10.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-136229
items.summary: When a signed OpenPGP/MIME message had no Date header, or one that could not be parsed, Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date. For S/MIME messages with more than one Date header, a later Date header could be used for the comparison. An attacker who had an old signed message could resend it and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-136228
items.summary: Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date for messages that were both signed and encrypted with OpenPGP/MIME. An attacker who had an old signed message could encrypt it to the victim and resend it with a current date, and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. items.title: CVE-2026-135813
items.summary: A flaw was found in Red Hat Enterprise Linux's qemu-kvm virtualization software. A privileged user inside a guest virtual machine could use this flaw to make the host QEMU process copy parts of its own memory into the guest's memory, where the attacker could read it. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to view portions of the host QEMU process memory from within a guest, potentially exposing sensitive information that could aid in further attacks. The highest threat from this vulnerability is to confidentiality.

The identifier of the patch is 3ae60d57ea6840bb33456596ad799b0a39ca94a2. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-126536
items.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the XLSX tax-import workflow. An authenticated Manager can import HTML in a tax name and associate the tax with an item. When an Administrator attempts to disable that tax, Akaunting renders the original stored name in an error notification through Vue v-html, causing attacker-controlled markup to execute within the browser of another authenticated user.

items.summary: MCUboot's PSA-crypto ECDSA adapter parses the RFC 5480 DER signature with parse_signature_from_rfc5480_encoding() in boot/bootutil/include/bootutil/crypto/ecdsa.h, which takes no length argument. bootutil_ecdsa_verify() explicitly discards the signature length ((void)slen;) and the parser walks the encoding using length bytes read from the buffer itself (r_len = sig[3], then a derived s_len), with no check that those offsets stay within the supplied signature. items.summary: MCUboot's Espressif port omits zeroization of two sensitive stack buffers in boot/espressif/hal/src/flash_encrypt.c. In check_and_generate_encryption_keys(), the freshly generated XTS-AES flash-encryption key is held in the stack array keys[BLOCKS_NEEDED][32] (flash_encrypt.c:216), written to eFuse via esp_efuse_write_keys(), and the function returns (flash_encrypt.c:243) without scrubbing it. items.title: CVE-2026-136136
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Netis WF2409E up to 20261026. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /cgi-bin/skk_set.cgi of the component CGI Interface. The manipulation of the argument app/password/new_pwd_confirm/passwd_set/mode_name/wl_link leads to improper authentication. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-16668
items.summary: The vendored zcbor decoder's zcbor_any_skip() in boot/zcbor/src/zcbor_decode.c descends one C-stack frame per level of CBOR nesting. On a list or map it copies the decoder state (memcpy(&state_copy, state, sizeof(zcbor_state_t))) and recurses once per member, with no depth cap: the skip path does not use zcbor's backup stack, and ZCBOR_MAX_ELEM_COUNT is SIZE_MAX, so nothing bounds how deep the recursion goes. items.title: CVE-2026-136135
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in louislam uptime-kuma up to e7420f8fa546a8baa7ac4bf9d10a32545d4346e0. Affected by this vulnerability is the function disableAPIKey/enableAPIKey of the file server/socket-handlers/api-key-socket-handler.js of the component API Key Management. The manipulation leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The researcher claims to have submitted a GHSA on the repository of the project.

items.title: CVE-2026-123626
items.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the company localisation date format. An authenticated Manager can store an arbitrary date format. When another authenticated user opens a recurring invoice, Akaunting formats dates with that value and sends the result to a raw HTML schedule description, causing attacker-controlled markup to execute in the victim's Akaunting origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-129839
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When processing log entries using certain JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) formatting templates, the service fails to properly escape input composed entirely of quotation marks or backslashes. An attacker who can supply logged input can exploit this issue to generate malformed JSON output, which may cause downstream log ingestion systems and parsers to reject log records.

items.title: CVE-2026-129832
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When process identification (PID) rewriting is enabled in the imuxsock module, a local attacker with access to the logging socket can send a crafted log message with an empty tag. This triggers an invalid memory write, causing the logging service to crash and resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

items.title: CVE-2026-136536
items.summary: LiteLLM is_request_body_safe Server-Side Request Forgery Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of LiteLLM. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the api_base parameter in chat completion requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a URI prior to accessing resources. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-29838.

items.title: CVE-2026-136540
items.summary: LiteLLM Secret Manager oidc Resolver Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of LiteLLM. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the secret resolution handler. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied input prior to using it to access environment variables. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-31482.

items.title: CVE-2026-136537
items.summary: LiteLLM key_management_endpoints Missing Authorization Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass security features on affected installations of LiteLLM. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the key_management_endpoints module. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the user. Was ZDI-CAN-32342.

items.title: CVE-2026-135328
items.summary: A flaw was found in kubevirt Containerized Data Importer (CDI). The CDI clone controller derives the CommonName of a CDI-CA-signed upload client certificate from the tenant-settable cdi.kubevirt.io/uploadClientName PVC annotation without validation, and the upload server authenticates clients only by certificate CA chain and CommonName string match, with no namespace or PVC binding. A namespace user can obtain a valid client certificate and write arbitrary data into any upload-ready PVC in any namespace whose upload Service is reachable from the cluster network, resulting in cross-namespace in…

items.title: CVE-2026-125734
items.summary: A flaw was found in GStreamer gst-plugins-bad mxfdemux handling of MXF Index Table Segment data. Crafted index metadata can lead to an out-of-range lookup during a seek and terminate the media process. A Fedora 43 test reproduced an assertion-triggered abort. The upstream advisory also notes possible information disclosure, but an attacker-visible leak has not been demonstrated.

A remote RTP sender or malicious RTSP server can send a short packet after a marker-bit packet, causing an unsigned wraparound in the VOP start-code search loop that reads past the buffer and causes denial of service.

Attackers can send short packets whose TOC entries all set the F bit, causing out-of-bounds frame data to be copied into decoder output, disclosing memory or crashing the client.

items.title: CVE-2026-136231
items.summary: A received message could include an attachment that referred to an arbitrary local file under a misleading name. If the user dragged that attachment into a message being composed and sent it, the contents of the referenced local file were included in the outgoing message. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-136230
items.summary: When a CardDAV address book was accessed through an HTTP proxy that requested authentication, Thunderbird could answer the proxy with the CardDAV server's username and password. This affected both setting up a new address book and syncing existing ones, where a saved password could be sent without any user interaction. A malicious or compromised proxy could use this to obtain the address book credentials, even for address books served over HTTPS. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-136227
items.summary: By combining several weaknesses, a crafted email could, when opened, inject commands into the authenticated IMAP connection, and load a web page with JavaScript enabled in place of the message. A bare carriage return in a header let the sender set Thunderbird's internal message flags, marking the message as a feed item and allowing its remote content to load. A reference to an embedded part placed inside an attribute value disclosed the message's internal IMAP URL to the sender. The message ID part of IMAP URLs was not validated, so loading a crafted variant of that URL sent arbitrary IMAP com…

items.title: CVE-2026-136226
items.summary: By adding a From header with lowercase name before the actual From header, an attacker could make Thunderbird display a different sender than the one used to verify an OpenPGP signature. Anyone whose key the victim had accepted could send messages that appeared to be validly signed by any other sender. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-65135
items.summary: NVIDIA Video Codec SDK for Linux contains a vulnerability where a user may cause a heap-based buffer overflow issue. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to code execution, data tampering, and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-136214
items.summary: Astra WordPress theme before 4.14.0 contains an improper input neutralization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with contributor-level privileges to inject unescaped CSS by submitting a crafted overlay-opacity value in the ast-page-background-meta or ast-content-background-meta REST fields. Attackers can store a malicious payload that, when rendered, causes an uncaught TypeError leading to a fatal error and HTTP 500 denial of service on PHP 8.0+, or injects arbitrary CSS into the page's style block on PHP 7.x enabling UI redress and content spoofing.

items.title: CVE-2026-123217
items.summary: Copeland XWEB Pro allows a remote, authenticated attacker to inject additional arguments into the wireless interface configuration command. Impact is limited to modification of the wireless interface state. Fixed in 1.16.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-135800
items.summary: A flaw has been found in hiyouga LLaMA-Factory up to 0.9.5. Affected is the function save_args/load_args of the file src/llamafactory/webui/runner.py of the component WebUI. This manipulation of the argument config_path causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-135414
items.summary: Server-side request forgery in Amazon OpenSearch Service service software before R20260720 might allow an authenticated user with permission to manage snapshots to make the service send requests to network destinations of their choosing via the snapshot repository endpoint setting. This issue is addressed in service software R20260720. Customers should update their domains to R20260720 or later.

items.title: CVE-2026-134066
items.summary: Improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic in the query construction of AWS Graph Explorer before 3.2.1 might allow an authenticated remote user with write access to the connected graph database to access and modify data in that database with Graph Explorer's privileges via a crafted property key or label that is used when another user performs a search. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to Graph Explorer version 3.2.1 or later.

items.title: CVE-2026-133934
items.summary: Improper authentication in the passkey signing service in Devolutions Remote Desktop Manager 2026.3.18.0 and earlier allows a local attacker to list and use the passkeys of another user via a pre-created legacy named pipe.

items.title: CVE-2026-133865
items.summary: Path traversal in the Microsoft VPN entry in Devolutions Remote Desktop Manager 2026.3.18.0 and earlier allows an attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended directory via a crafted .rdm file imported by a user.

items.title: CVE-2026-86156

SendEmailBlock and SQLQueryBlock logged in with the running user's saved SMTP or database credential to whatever server the graph's author put in the node's inputs, with no check that the login belonged to that server. items.title: CVE-2026-136159
items.summary: TypiCMS Core before 17.0.46 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability that allows authenticated users with "read users" permission to view plaintext api_token values for all users, including superusers, via the GET /api/users endpoint. Attackers can steal a superuser's non-expiring, non-rotatable api_token from the JSON response and use it to gain full superuser API access, enabling creation and deletion of users, roles, and all content.

items.title: CVE-2026-136172
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the OBJ exporter that allows attackers to corrupt memory via NaN vertex components breaking comparator ordering. Attackers can supply a crafted PLY file with NaN texture coordinates or vertex colors that, when exported to OBJ in libc++ builds, writes file-controlled data past a heap buffer and crashes the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-136171
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in BVHLoader.cpp that allows attackers to read freed aiNode objects because the mNodes vector is never cleared between files. Attackers can supply multiple BVH files to an application reusing one Importer instance, causing CreateAnimation to copy freed mName data into channel names, crashing the application or exposing heap contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-136170
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in OpenGEXImporter.cpp because InternReadFile does not reset cached importer state between files. Attackers can supply OpenGEX files to applications reusing one Importer instance, causing freed node, camera, and material pointers to corrupt heap memory and crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-136169
items.summary: Cockpit CMS through 2.14.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with content create or update permission to inject script via unescaped linked item _id values. Attackers can save an item whose link _id contains a double quote and HTML markup, executing script when administrators view the content dashboard or collection list.

items.title: CVE-2026-136167
items.summary: vedo through 2026.6.3 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted .npy or .npz files loaded with allow_pickle=True. Attackers can embed an object with a malicious __reduce__ method in mesh, assembly, scene or font files to run code with the victim's privileges when opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-136166
items.summary: Wallabag from 2.0.0-beta.1 before 2.6.16 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to annotate other users' entries by referencing global entry IDs. Attackers can send requests to the /annotations/{entry} or /api/annotations/{entry} routes to inject annotations into victims' private entries, API output, and exports, and enumerate existing entry IDs.

items.title: CVE-2026-75582
items.summary: Frappe LMS before 2.65.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows Batch Evaluators to modify any evaluation because the LMS Certificate Evaluation doctype lacks a has_permission scoping hook. Attackers can call the whitelisted create_lms_certificate method with any evaluation name to issue certificates for unassigned evaluations or learners outside their batches.

items.title: CVE-2026-136160
items.summary: Pyro through 1.9.2 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability in ParamStoreDict.load() that calls torch.load with weights_only=False, unpickling arbitrary Python objects. Attackers can trick users into loading a crafted parameter file defining __reduce__ to execute code with the privileges of the Python process.

items.title: CVE-2026-136131
items.summary: hping3 through commit 3547c76 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in display_ipopt() that allows remote attackers to overflow the static 40-byte old_rr buffer via a crafted IP Record Route option. Attackers acting as the probed host, on-path, or spoofing the target can send replies with option lengths up to 255 to hping3 running with -G/--rroute, corrupting global memory and crashing hping3.

items.title: CVE-2026-131902
items.summary: XML Injection vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_s3 allows an attacker who controls an object version id passed to ExAws.S3.delete_multiple_objects/3 to add objects to the batch delete. delete_multiple_objects/3 in lib/ex_aws/s3.ex builds the request body by placing each object's version between tags without XML escaping. A version such as v1important-filexv2 closes the caller's object and opens new ones, so S3 deletes objects the application never listed, including other users' objects in the same bucket. This issue affects ex_aws_s3: from 2.0.0 before 2.6.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-136186
items.summary: plugNmeet-server before 2.5.3 contains an authorization flaw in PollsController.HandleUserSubmitResponse that allows authenticated room participants to submit poll votes as other users by supplying an arbitrary UserId. Attackers can set UserId to another participant's id to cast votes on their behalf or block their legitimate votes, manipulating poll results.

items.title: CVE-2026-136185
items.summary: Prismor before 1.57.0 contains a wildcard CORS misconfiguration and missing authentication in its local HTTP API that allows remote attackers to overwrite security policies via cross-origin requests. Attackers can lure a developer to a malicious page that sends PUT requests to /api/policy/global or /api/policy/project, disabling AI agent guardrails and reading session and event data.

items.title: CVE-2026-134019
items.summary: PyTables is a Python package to manage extremely large amounts of data. In 3.11.1 and earlier, tables/attributeset.py treats a NumPy bytes scalar ending in a period as a pickled Python object and calls pickle.loads() when the attribute is accessed through AttributeSet.__getattr__ or AttributeSet.__getitem__. Opening an attacker-controlled HDF5 file and reading an affected metadata attribute can execute attacker-controlled code in the consumer’s process. No fixed version is available as of this review.

items.title: Sei Giga
items.summary: arXiv:2505.14914v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce the Sei Giga, a multi-concurrent producer parallelized execution EVM layer one blockchain.
